description: This PHP source file defines a client class 'IVSRealTimeClient' for interacting with the Amazon Interactive Video Service RealTime API within the AWS SDK. It includes method annotations for various API operations, indicating asynchronous and synchronous methods for resource management such as creating, deleting, and listing configurations, participants, and stages.

classes.name: IVSRealTimeClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Interactive Video Service RealTime, providing methods to manage live video streaming sessions and configurations.

methods.name: createEncoderConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new encoder configuration for a streaming session.

methods.name: createIngestConfiguration
methods.description: Creates an ingest configuration for live video input.

methods.name: createParticipantToken
methods.description: Generates a token to join a streaming session as a participant.

methods.name: createStage
methods.description: Creates a new stage for live streaming.

methods.name: createStorageConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a storage configuration for recording streams.

methods.name: deletePublicKey
methods.description: Deletes a public key used for authentication.

methods.name: disconnectParticipant
methods.description: Disconnects a participant from a stage.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves details of a public key.

methods.name: getStageSession
methods.description: Retrieves session details for a stage.

methods.name: importPublicKey
methods.description: Imports a public key for authentication.

methods.name: listParticipants
methods.description: Lists all participants in a session.

methods.name: listStageSessions
methods.description: Lists sessions associated with a stage.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags applied to a resource.
